604:t_7:56.en:
$$シン$$
「Fine by me. That's what we intend, too.」

604:t_7:57.en:
$$葵$$
「So it's finally the decisive battle with the Empire.」

604:t_7:58.en:
$$タケル$$
「We've been fighting for this very moment.」

604:t_7:59.en:
$$カレン$$
「You've barely gotten back and it's already hectic, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

604:t_7:60.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm fine. I'll work to make up for all the time I spent resting.」

604:t_7:61.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You seem really full of energy, somehow.」

604:t_7:62.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Maybe it's because I have the energy of two people.」

604:t_7:64.en:
$$スズネ$$
「She was my other self, and we tried to cancel out each other's existence...」

604:t_7:65.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But she was a part of me, too... When $n said he'd save us both, we understood that.」

604:t_7:66.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's why we were able to become one.」

604:t_7:67.en:
$$アルト$$
「According to Lieutenant $$カナリア$$, with ordinary dual personalities one of the two eventually disappears, but in Miss $$スズネ$$'s case, they fused, right?」

604:t_7:68.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I think we have $n to thank for this too, for overcoming those conflicting emotions.」

604:t_7:70.en:
$$宗介$$
「He's by himself, saying he wants to collect his thoughts.」

604:t_7:71.en:
$$カレン$$
「Even though Miss $$スズネ$$ has finally come back?」

604:t_7:74.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's not unthinkable. I know from experience how feelings can run abnormally high when you're reunited.」

604:t_7:76.en:
$$アルト$$
「Well, she's probably tired, too. So many things happened one after another.」

604:t_7:77.en:
$$甲児$$
「It started with the secret of $$ラプラスの箱$$, then $$クロノ$$'s doctrine... the showdown with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...」

604:t_7:78.en:
$$アルト$$
「And then $$アサキム$$ broke away from $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, and on top of that, $$ガドライト#pilot$$ was alive, too...」

604:t_7:79.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And on top of all that, $n brought out a new power in $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$.」

604:t_7:80.en:
$$カレン$$
「Is that the power of love between the two of you?」

604:t_7:81.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'd be happy if it were.」

604:t_7:82.en:
$$甲児$$
「S-Somehow, Miss $$スズネ$$... you really have changed a little...」

604:t_7:83.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Right. Before, whenever this kind of topic came up, she'd either deny it with everything she had or brush it off...」

604:t_7:86.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's right. Until now, I was a teacher, and I was older, so I was too concerned with all sorts of positions.」

604:t_7:87.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But coming into contact with her, someone who seeks freedom, made me want to show more of myself, too.」

604:t_7:88.en:
$$アルト$$
「Could it be that the glasses with your new pilot suit are also...?」

604:t_7:89.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Maybe. Actually, I... like myself better with glasses on.」

604:t_7:90.en:
$$スズネ$$
「When I first noticed another self inside me, I was frightened and disgusted, but now I can accept it...」

604:t_7:91.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I think I have fighting alongside $n to thank for this, too.」

604:t_7:92.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You should be saying that to $n, not to us.」

604:t_7:95.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Isn't that $$アムブリエル$$ coming out again...?」

604:t_7:96.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「That's not it... Miss $$スズネ$$ just became honest.」

604:t_7:97.en:
$$カレン$$
「Right, right. Inside, she hasn't changed at all.」

604:t_7:98.en:
$$アルト$$
「With the big showdown ahead of us, it means a lot that Miss $$スズネ$$ is back.」

604:t_7:99.en:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah... Now that we know how much more powerful an enemy the $$サイデリアル$$ are than we imagined, we have to steel ourselves, too.」

604:t_7:100.en:
$$宗介$$
「Those who have managed humanity's evolution across countless parallel worlds for hundreds of years...」

604:t_7:101.en:
$$アルト$$
「If we don't defeat them, humanity can't move on to the future...」

604:t_7:102.en:
$$甲児$$
「Just you wait, $$皇帝アウストラリス$$... If that's how you want it, we'll storm into $$ラース・バビロン$$ ourselves.」

604:t_7:107.en:
$n
「...So you've reconciled with $$アムブリエル$$.」

604:t_7:108.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes... She and I melted together, and we coexist inside this body.」

604:t_7:109.en:
$n
「But I'm glad... that Miss $$スズネ$$ came back to us...」

604:t_7:110.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm glad I could come back, too... and that I can be together with you like this again, $n...」

604:t_7:113.en:
$n
「...There's so much I want to talk about. About $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$, about $$マキ#pilot$$, about $$ティティ$$...」

604:t_7:115.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I know. First, rest your body well.」

604:t_7:116.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'll come again when it's dinnertime. Get a little sleep until then.」

604:t_7:123.en:
$n
(Back then, I definitely saw Miss $$スズネ$$ die...)

604:t_7:124.en:
$n
(In that instant, I denied what was happening before my eyes... And that's exactly how it turned out.)

604:t_7:125.en:
$n
(Judging by how $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and $$アサキム$$ reacted, time definitely went back a little...)

604:t_7:126.en:
$n
(At that moment, I felt all twelve $$スフィア$$s...)

604:t_7:127.en:
$n
(I'd heard that gathering several $$スフィア$$s lets them show more power than a single one, but...)

604:t_7:128.en:
$n
(If all twelve $$スフィア$$s are gathered, can even what has already happened be changed...?)

604:t_7:129.en:
$n
(But using a power like that can't be allowed... If something like that existed, the world would be thrown into chaos...)

604:t_7:130.en:
$n
(If there's someone who could use it without any doubt or hesitation, then that would be...)

604:t_10:4.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Welcome. As shop owner $$ＡＧ$$ is absent today, we will be running the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ under our caretaker service.」

604:t_10:5.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Furthermore, as for the congratulations to ace pilots, we ask your understanding that they will be held on another occasion.」

604:t_10:6.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Now then, everyone, please take your time and enjoy your shopping.」

605:t_000:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「Once $$クロノ$$ learns we've obtained $$ラプラスの箱$$, they'll send a unit against us.」

605:t_000:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「While Her Highness $$ミネバ$$ reveals the truth of the Box, we will defend $$メガラニカ$$.」

605:t_000:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$クロノ$$'s field units have hardly any strength left. The Empire's forces will probably move, too.」
